cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22.1.0)
set(CMAKE_MODULE_PATH "/home/ws/Desktop/RetroScope/libarchive-versions/v3.6.0/build/cmake")
cmake_policy(SET CMP0126 OLD)
project(CMAKE_TRY_COMPILE C)
set(CMAKE_VERBOSE_MAKEFILE 1)
set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS "-g -O0 -fsanitize=address -fno-omit-frame-pointer -Wno-deprecated-declarations -Wno-array-parameter -Wall -Wformat -Wformat-security -Werror -ffunction-sections -fdata-sections")
set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS "${CMAKE_C_FLAGS} ${COMPILE_DEFINITIONS}")
set(CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS "${CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS} ${EXE_LINKER_FLAGS}")
include_directories(${INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES})
set(CMAKE_SUPPRESS_REGENERATION 1)
link_directories(${LINK_DIRECTORIES})
cmake_policy(SET CMP0065 NEW)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0083 OLD)
set(CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "/home/ws/Desktop/RetroScope/libarchive-versions/build-asan-v3.6.0/CMakeFiles/CMakeTmp")
add_executable(cmTC_673be "/home/ws/Desktop/RetroScope/libarchive-versions/build-asan-v3.6.0/CMakeFiles/CheckTypeSize/MODE_T.c")
target_link_libraries(cmTC_673be  )
